title: Onboarding micro-illustrations and capacity selector states
creator: Marisol Chen
description: Create a compact set of onboarding visuals for Dedicated capacity onboarding that includes: 1) a horizontal carousel of micro-illustrations for the quickstart flow, 2) component states for the capacity selector (preset tiers, custom slider, estimated throughput cost), and 3) a succinct SLA explainer card with fallback/timeout visuals. These assets will be used in the Quickstart modal, welcome email, and the guided tour overlay. The goal is concise, scannable visuals that reduce first-time setup time and clarify autoscale behavior and SLA trade-offs.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file contains a carousel artboard with 5 micro-illustrations and production-ready PNG exports at 2x for web
Capacity selector components: preset chips, custom slider with tooltip, throughput estimate panel, and empty-state illustration
SLA explainer card: short copy + three visual states (green nominal, amber degraded, red fallback) with accessible color contrast
All copy reviewed by PM and Legal; microcopy below 120 characters per card; translations-ready strings separated in the file
Design tokens and spacings documented in the artboard; handoff notes for frontend with class names and animation specs
design_links: Figma: Compact carousel master and component library - https://figma.com/file/Redwood/DED-Quickstart-Carousel?node-id=234:12
